primary_sources.title: Friedhelm Waldhausen, On irreducible 3-manifolds which are sufficiently large, Ann.Math.87(1968),56-88
primary_sources.used_statement: Theorem6.1 printed77/PDF23, complete statement and boundary-relative conclusion visually rechecked: irreducible and boundary-irreducible source and target, sufficiently large target, nonzero source pi1, injective map of pairs implies a covering except for a product over a closed orientable surface. Source has one boundary, excluding that product, and the pi1 isomorphism gives degree one. Peripheral map construction is proved using asphericity; no unrestricted group recognition is imported.

primary_sources.title: Allen Hatcher, Notes on Basic 3-Manifold Topology
primary_sources.used_statement: Prime decomposition Theorem1.5 and prime/irreducible Proposition1.4; Seifert irreducibility Proposition1.12; essential surfaces Proposition1.13 on printed19/PDF20; essential-annulus and boundary-fiber uniqueness Lemmas1.14-1.15 on printed20/PDF21, with all four product/Klein exceptions explicitly excluded by negative orbifold Euler characteristic; JSJ uniqueness Theorem1.9 and asphericity Corollary3.9. Complete printed19-20 pages rendered and visually inspected. Free-product indecomposability and annulus slope arguments are separately written, not inferred from H1.

primary_sources.title: Tetsuya Ito, A Note on Chirally Cosmetic Surgery on Cable Knots, Canad.Math.Bull.64(2021),163-173
primary_sources.used_statement: Section2 printed165/PDF3, already visually audited: cable fiber slopes, distance-one companion filling n/p^2, and distance>1 genuine terminal Seifert JSJ piece. Winding p in the new proof is winding q in the source. Used for marked source surgery collapse and radial model decomposition; no cosmetic-surgery conclusion is imported.

primary_sources.title: Peter Scott, The geometries of 3-manifolds, Bull. London Math. Soc.15(1983),401-487
primary_sources.used_statement: Seifert presentations, negative base-orbifold geometry and Theorem3.6 unbranched fiber/base covering behavior. The ordinary simple/index-three branched fiber extension is the separately proved local model retained in PF2RULED34, not claimed as a consequence of the unbranched theorem alone.

primary_sources.title: Grisha Perelman, Finite extinction time for the solutions to the Ricci flow on certain three-manifolds (2003)
primary_sources.used_statement: Section1.4 only for Poincare: a simply connected prime closed summand is S3. No general spherical, graph-manifold or H1-only recognition is assumed in the new radial argument.

primary_sources.title: Lisa Lokteva, Surgeries on Iterated Torus Knots Bounding Rational Homology 4-Balls, Proc. Edinburgh Math. Soc.66(2023),557-578, author version
primary_sources.used_statement: Proposition5, printed8/PDF9, already visually audited: positive algebraic iterated cabling and alpha_i>p_i*p_(i-1)*alpha_(i-1). It applies to the local source reference branch. For target exteriors homeomorphic to it, only absolute slope growth is transferred by the new JSJ/fiber-homology argument. No positivity assumption is imposed on arbitrary target infinity cabling.

retained_scope: No new primary downloads required; exact retained source files are reused read-only. New all-depth lemmas and all-case quartic proof are written in the canonical note.
